name: mailbun
description: Local-first email client — multi-account IMAP/SMTP, unified inbox, threading, search.
author: Mailbun

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && run-p -r dev electron:dev:window
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run server:bundle && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder && npm run rebuild:node
scripts.electron:publish: npm run build && npm run server:bundle && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --publish always
